recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5476 unless a future work-group review wants to revisit unrelated examples that legitimately use the W3C Atom namespace outside the old FHIR Bundle-as-Atom model.
issue_request: FHIR-5476 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core XML issue from the ITS work group. The ballot comment objected that the XML page still described XML bundles as Atom format and asked to update that section for the Bundle resource, or at least state that Atom use was deprecated. The recorded resolution was to remove the last references to Atom.
initial_application: The Jira comments say svn 4395 removed the last Atom references. Git history contains the corresponding converted commit 6e342eaf1df2261471456769618097063a016c17, "#5476 - remove last references to Atom", with git-svn-id build@4395. That commit changed Bundle/Atom wording across source/basic/basic-notes.xml, source/claim/claim-message.xml, source/comparison-v2.html, source/documents.html, source/ehr-fm.html, source/narrative.html, source/other/other-notes.xml, and source/search.html. It did not need to change source/xml.html, consistent with the Jira note that the cited XML section was not found at application time.
additional_context: The current XML format page is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini. Current source/xml.html contains no Atom/atom/xml.html#atom references, and exact searches for the old Atom-bundle wording find no current source matches. The files from the #5476 application that still exist in the current checkout also contain no Atom-like references, while removed files are no longer current build targets. The only top-level source HTML exact atom hit is source/history.html release-history text saying the January 2015 ballot replaced atom/taglist with native Bundle format, which is historical context rather than a stale recommendation. FHIR-5318 is a same-family issue resolved as already done by #5476 and already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: This result intentionally makes no source change because the current active source already satisfies FHIR-5476: FHIR XML/Bundles are no longer documented as Atom format, and the remaining historical mention does not contradict the requested cleanup.
